title: UN Security Council: West Bank at 'Breaking Point' Amid Settler Violence, Displacement Surge
detail: UN Deputy Special Coordinator for the Middle East Peace Process Ramiz Alakbarov told the Security Council the occupied West Bank is at a 'breaking point' as Israel pursues what officials described as 'de facto annexation.' As of August 10, 76 Palestinians (including 18 children) had been killed in the West Bank in 2026 by Israeli forces or settlers; 174 Palestinian children have been verified killed since January 2024. The UN documented more than 1,430 settler-violence incidents in 2026 affecting roughly 260 Palestinian communities, and roughly 3,800 Palestinians — nearly half of them children — have been displaced this year through settler violence, demolitions and evictions. Officials cited Israeli approval of about 12,360 new settlement housing units, $431 million allocated for 34 new settlements, and Israel's continued withholding of roughly $6 billion in Palestinian tax revenues.

media.caption: UN officials warn the West Bank faces 'de facto annexation' as settler violence and displacement surge — August 11, 2026

title: Israeli Ambassador Danon Defends West Bank Settlements at UN Security Council: 'Not Going Anywhere'
detail: Responding to the Security Council's 'breaking point' briefing on the West Bank, Israeli UN Ambassador Danny Danon told the Council that Jewish settlements in the West Bank 'are not going anywhere,' citing the Jewish people's 'eternal bond with the land of Israel' and describing settlements as 'not temporary outposts, but homes, families, and strong, beautiful communities.' Danon accused the Council of applying a double standard by focusing on settler violence while, in his view, giving insufficient attention to Palestinian attacks on Israelis.

media.caption: Israeli Ambassador Danny Danon defends West Bank settlements before the UN Security Council — August 11, 2026

title: Israeli Forces Demolish Homes, Arrest 23 Palestinians as Settlers Attack Farmers Near Al-Mughayyir
detail: Israeli forces conducted widespread West Bank operations on August 11, 2026: 23 Palestinians were arrested, including two children (one with a disability). The home of Farouq Ramadan was demolished in Tal village near Nablus over his death during a July 24 settler confrontation, and another home was demolished near Yatta in the Hebron governorate, displacing nine Palestinians. Twelve commercial warehouses in Anza village and an agricultural facility in Yarza were bulldozed, and a demolition notice was issued for the Khallat al-Dabaa school in Masafer Yatta. Separately, roughly 60 settlers attacked Palestinian farmers plowing land in Al-Mughayyir, wounding six including children, and settlers destroyed water pipeline sections in Khirbet Ras al-Ahmar, cutting supplies to 30 herding families.

media.caption: Israeli forces demolish homes and detain Palestinians across the West Bank as settler violence surges — August 11, 2026
